note: Held/slow ERP state, re-anchored on the 1st business day of each month (or when the real-yield master / SP500 normalized series publish a new vintage). Between anchors ONLY the daily real curve + norm_ey move.

sources.reals_5_10_20_30: Treasury Daily Par Real Yield Curve (5/7/10/20/30); 7y optional belly point
sources.nominal_1y: Treasury Daily Par Yield Curve, 1Y tenor
sources.one_year_real_rule: real_1y = nominal_1y - breakeven1y (breakeven held from the monthly master vintage)
sources.norm_ey_rule: norm_ey = 100 * normalized_X4 * cpi_factor / sp_close  (SP500 normalized earnings LEVEL / real price; price is daily)

derivation.breakeven1y: EXPINF1YR (FRED) + wedge, where wedge = 2.76 minus EXPINF1YR read at 2026-06-30. BOTH halves come from the same series by construction. Expected inflation moves; the inflation-risk-plus-liquidity wedge is HELD and is NOT a measurement -- open register.
derivation.cost: build_erp_daily.cost_of_year(), glide continues at its own rate, floored at 0.25 (reached mid-2032). James's ruling 2026-08-19.
derivation.fey_in_D_in: prior state replayed through build_asof at the prior month's last business day
derivation.normalized_X4_cpi_factor: CARRIED FORWARD from the prior vintage; normalization job not built. Worth <1bp -- see the inline note.
